# Restropi

> Restropi is a restaurant and café management app for India. One app for billing with UPI QR and GST, kitchen orders (KOT) on a phone or tablet, tables, QR ordering and payment from the table, stock and dish costing, staff, guests and daily reports. It runs on the phone, tablet or laptop a restaurant already has, in English, Marathi and Hindi.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.restropi.com/): what Restropi does, who it is for
- [Pricing](https://www.restropi.com/pricing): Starter ₹699, Growth ₹1,999 and Pro ₹2,999 a month, one price per restaurant (Pro covers up to 3 outlets); Chain for 4+ outlets
- [About](https://www.restropi.com/about): who makes Restropi (Pune, Maharashtra) and what it does
- [Restaurant billing software](https://www.restropi.com/restaurant-billing-software): GST bills, UPI QR with the exact amount, discounts, coupons
- [QR code ordering](https://www.restropi.com/qr-code-ordering): table QR menu, order to the kitchen, pay from the table
- [KOT software](https://www.restropi.com/kot-software): kitchen screen on any phone or tablet, stations, read-aloud
- [Café billing app](https://www.restropi.com/cafe-billing-software): counter orders with tokens, self-service QR, stamp cards
- [Restaurant inventory software](https://www.restropi.com/restaurant-inventory-software): recipe-based stock, counts, forecast, buy list
- [Restaurant POS in Pune](https://www.restropi.com/restaurant-pos-pune): Marathi/Hindi/English, setup help in Pune, Satara, Kolhapur
- [Privacy policy](https://www.restropi.com/privacy): personal data and cookies
